entities.summary: Xuanzong, a notable figure in the history of China, associated with Tang Dynasty (712–763). Preceded by Lushan Rebellion and Wu Zetian becomes China's only female emperor, founding the brief Zhou dynasty. Their legacy influenced Battle of Talas — Tang defeated by Abbasids; papermaking spreads westward and Lushan Rebellion — one of the deadliest conflicts in human history.
